'''Hiro''' (Japanese: '''ヒロ''' ''Hiro'') is the protagonist of [[PT17]].
[[File:Young Hiro POKÉTOON.png|thumb|left|250px|Young Hiro]]
Hiro is a young boy who lives in [[Johto]]. He grew alongside a {{p|Cyndaquil}} and an {{p|Aipom}}, and his dream was to collect the eight {{pkmn|Gym}} [[Badge]]s in order to take on the {{pkmn|Champion}}. One day, while wandering around in the forest by his house, he met a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Murkrow}}, who he quickly befriended after escaping from a {{p|Skarmory}}. They made matching necklaces from fragments of Skarmory's feathers and set up a [[Secret Base]] in a small cave near the forest. Then, suddenly, Hiro had to be taken to the hospital for unknown reasons.

After Hiro got discharged and returned home, he had some trouble remembering some things of his past, such as the way Cyndaquil liked to be petted and the greeting he had with Aipom. Initially, he didn't remember Murkrow at all, but his memories were slowly piecing together as he readjusted himself back home. At night, he saw Murkrow flying into the nearby forest and decided to follow it, which led him to their Secret Base. Outside, the Murkrow was being attacked by a horde of {{p|Meowth}} trying to snatch its necklace away. In that moment, Hiro finally remembered his time with Murkrow, helped it clear the Meowth away, and reunited with his friend, promising that they will be going on a {{pkmn|journey}} together.
